parsed.explanation: Combined regime: federal binary-sex document/facility rules and entry screening create universal-exposure risk, with birth-sex custody and documented immigration-detention abuse if detained; this state has no adult facility or care ban and municipal protections cover 46%, but statewide nondiscrimination and hate-crime gaps limit recourse elsewhere. Courts and injunctions partially mitigate, yet the operative federal restrictions and custody severity keep the case in the Elevated Risk band, below jurisdictions where remedies reliably prevent detention.

entry_documents.exposure: Passport sex-marker binary restored, foreign ministry stopped X/non-birth-sex passports, passports confiscated/blocked and travellers stranded; 2025 cable orders refusal where documents cast reasonable doubt on sex.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports remain valid until expiration, fraud-based lifetime bar requires four elements and is never automatic, and passport policy is under court challenge.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy can trigger refusal, possible wilful-misrepresentation finding, then detention and birth-sex placement.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody reports of forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse; national corrections model includes hair cutting, hormone removal and psychiatric substitution; a bathroom-trespass arrestee was held in men's ward.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Courts have enjoined some orders and hear challenges; no documented remedy specifically shown to end custody abuse.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry or facility referral can move a visitor into immigration/criminal custody where birth-sex placement magnifies harm.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal order bars government-funded facilities matching gender identity; many states have bans and four criminalise in some circumstances, including trespass after refusal to depart.
federal_state_facilities.protection: This state has no statewide adult restroom/changing-room ban; only one school-district student policy is documented, and four municipalities protect public accommodations.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal buildings and other states impose birth-sex access even though local adult facilities are not statewide-banned.

care_services.exposure: National youth-care/hostile funding measures and 27-state youth bans create climate risk; no documented adult-visitor HRT import or clinic rule in this state.
care_services.protection: Division evidence states no statewide ban on gender-affirming care for adults; youth-care board action is a recommendation/draft, not operative.
care_services.interaction: Federal youth-care pressure does not document denial of routine adult care locally, but emergency/ward placement by documents remains uncertain.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Executive order defines sex as binary at birth, rescinds pronoun/name policies, directs investigation of schools, and 2026 strategy prioritises 'radically pro-transgender' groups; passport cable treats doubt about sex as refusal ground.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Several orders blocked/enjoined, national employment and hate-crime rulings/statute remain, and marriage recognition is nationwide.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat-framing increases document scrutiny and makes local discretion less predictable.

minors_guardians.exposure: State education board bars trans girls from female sports; one district requires birth-sex bathrooms for students; medical board draft would discipline under-18 transition care; national order targets teachers facilitating social transition.
minors_guardians.protection: Draft youth regulation had not completed vetting/comment and is not operative; governor's statewide student facility limit failed; no documented visitor/minor entry ban.
minors_guardians.interaction: A travelling minor is not documented as enrolled, so school/sports rules are mainly climate/edge exposure unless seeking school or care.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: State hate-crime statute omits gender identity; outside four municipalities no state/municipal discrimination recourse; polls show majority support birth-sex documents, indicating friction/hostility risk.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; municipal ordinances protect about 46% of population; no trans-specific violence count is documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police response and remedy depend sharply on municipality, with no state enhancement for bias violence.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Remedies are slow, jurisdiction-dependent and unresolved; national measures vary over time, enforcement of municipal ordinances is not sourced, and court success is not assured.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Civil-liberties suit, injunctions, legal-aid passport guidance, municipal protections and voters rejecting one discriminatory ballot measure show functioning contestation.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Working courts mitigate some federal orders but do not cancel documented facility, entry or custody practices while they operate.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower risk than 0.35-A: no routine visitor register, entry ban or departure-flight system, and courts have enjoined orders; entry refusal is discretionary and fraud bar is not automatic.

Similar to 0.55-B: extended screening, discretionary entry refusal and birth-sex facility/ward rules can cause delay, humiliation and loss of plans, though documented custody abuse makes this case somewhat more severe.

Higher risk than 0.75-C: unlike brief detention reliably ending in release, this regime documents possible permanent ineligibility, federal facility exclusion and patterned custody abuse, with no reliable local remedy outside municipalities.

parsed.synthesis: The traveller encounters a Protective local layer—no statewide adult facility/care ban, municipal coverage for 46%—inside a hostile federal layer of binary documents, facility exclusion, entry doubt and birth-sex custody. That interaction means local tolerance does not neutralise border, federal-building or detention exposure. For a minor, youth/sports/school rules add pressure but the care draft is not operative. Courts provide real but incomplete mitigation, leaving mid-Elevated Risk.
